subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should this issue stay open as the canonical owner for partial current-turn media delivery, or should it be closed because the shipped single-image hydration path covers the original report?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 cover the simple current image path, but the open closing PR changes the shared partial-media fallback contract and still lacks real Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep canonical until PR resolution
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers decide whether to repair, land, or close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94139.

options.title: Close as shipped single-image fix
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide the partial-media PR is out of scope for this report and should be closed or retargeted separately.

options.title: Request live repro first
options.body: Ask for a fresh current-release Telegram DM image run that identifies whether the remaining failure is partial media, model vision support, or path resolution.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical until PR resolution
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers decide whether to repair, land, or close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94139.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed the same resolver's image-order contract and are the clearest owner for the partial-media contract choice.
